C01.self.text: As a referral hospital it serves patients from the whole region, and per-resident figures for its surroundings do not describe its reach.

C01.nearby.text: There is a large hospital in the radius that serves patients from the whole region, and per-resident figures for the surroundings do not describe its reach.

C03b.text: The estimate is imprecise: census tracts here are large and the radius covers only part of them.

C04.precarious.text: In the radius, {%.precarious_radius} of households discharge sewage into rudimentary pits, ditches or rivers.

C04.septic.text: In the radius, most households off the network use septic tanks; {%.precarious_radius} have precarious disposal.

C08b.text: A long stay reflects the kind of cases treated, chronic or highly complex, and not the quality of care.

C10.text: There are no disease data for areas as small as the radius: the following figures are for the whole municipality.

C10.district.text: There are no disease data for areas as small as the radius: the following figures are for the district.

C12.text: In {%.peak_year}, an epidemic year, the municipality's rate reached {%.peak_municipality}.

C17.text: District figures come from the city's own systems (SMS-SP) and municipal ones from DATASUS; the two are not directly comparable.

C18b.text: {%.ill_defined_municipality} of deaths in the municipality have no defined cause, which makes this profile unreliable.

C14b.text: With so many private services in the radius, being far from public primary care does not by itself mean a lack of care: some residents use private health plans.

C10.district_municipality.text: There are no disease data for areas as small as the radius: the following figures are for the district and the municipality.

C19.text: The model uses only census income, housing and sanitation: the difference points to factors it does not measure, without saying which.

C21b.text: Close to the edge of the metropolitan region, the catchment leaves out residents of neighbouring municipalities outside it.

C22.text: The catchment's residents live on average {%.distance_catchment} from the unit in a straight line; {%.far_catchment} of them, over {k.two_km} away.

C23.text: The expected figure accounts for the diagnosis, age and admission type, elective or emergency, of the patients, at the death rates of the same groups in the metropolitan region's hospitals; it does not account for the severity of each case, transfers between hospitals or palliative care, and mortality alone does not measure the quality of care.

C23b.text: Deaths far below the expected figure usually mean patients less ill than the average for their diagnosis, transfers of the gravest cases to other hospitals, or some cases recorded under another establishment, not better care in itself.

C23c.text: Hospitals taking the gravest, palliative or long-stay cases record more deaths; being above the range calls for checking the records and patients' profile, not proof of worse care.

C23d.text: The remaining admissions are recorded as elective, although the hospital only takes referred patients; if some of them were emergencies, the expected rate is underestimated.
